title: Aurora Fracture Bunny
description: A surreal digital painting shows a large cracked stone arch resembling broken rabbit ears or a fractured heart, set against a vibrant pink, green, and yellow aurora borealis. Below, colorful smoke, glowing rings, scattered dots, and heartbeat waveforms rise from a dark textured ground, with a small pink heart at the center.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a massive broken stone arch shaped like giant cracked rabbit ears or a fractured heart floating in a dark sky. Vibrant pink green and yellow aurora borealis swirls above. From the base, long flowing pink ribbons, colorful smoke trails, glowing yellow rings, multicolored dots, and bright heartbeat waveforms emanate upwards. A small glowing pink heart sits at the center where the forms converge. Dark textured ground below, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere.
